title: Inyong Ora Gugup
subject: A Purwokerto graduate in a Jakarta job interview keeps her standard Indonesian polished until the interviewer slips, and he turns out to be from Cilacap, so she answers in ngapak and both of them laugh.
caption: Banyumasan calung-lengger pop in a slendro-style five-note scale. Bamboo calung gambang barung in fast interlocking melody, gambang penerus in double-time fills, bamboo dhendhem and kenong marking the slow skeleton melody, blown bamboo gong bumbung on phrase endings, kendang ciblon with snappy slaps and rolls. dry natural bamboo-percussion ensemble recording, close-miked, lively and warm. Female vocal, bright mid-high register with light sindhen-style ornaments, clearly sung, mostly Indonesian with a few Banyumasan words. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 120 BPM, C major. Comic, nimble, proud. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no electric guitar, no synth pads, no Western drum kit.
lyrics:
[Intro - calung gambang and kendang ciblon]
[Verse 1]
Lantai dua belas gedung di Sudirman
Aku duduk tegak, map di pangkuan
Bahasaku rapi, kalimatku baku
Dalam hati bilang, ayo, Ning, tenang
[Pre-Chorus]
Bapak penguji tanya soal kelemahan
Aku jawab pelan, sangat sopan
[Chorus]
Inyong ora gugup, inyong ora gugup
Kepriwe kabare, Pak, rika sehat?
Inyong ora gugup, inyong wong Banyumas
Ngapak ya ngapak, tetap tegak
[Verse 2]
Bapak itu tiba-tiba menyahut
Mendoannya enak ya, Mbak, di Purwokerto
Logatnya kental, ujung kata mengalun
Aku terdiam, lalu mataku melebar
[Pre-Chorus]
Pak, sampeyan wong Cilacap, ya?
Ruangan hening, lalu kami tertawa
[Chorus]
Inyong ora gugup, inyong ora gugup
Kepriwe kabare, Pak, rika sehat?
Inyong ora gugup, rika wong Cilacap
Ngapak ya ngapak, kita sama
[Chorus]
Inyong ora gugup, inyong ora gugup
Kepriwe kabare, Pak, aku diterima?
Inyong ora gugup, inyong wong Banyumas
Ngapak ya ngapak, kerja mulai Senin
[Outro - kendang ciblon rolls, bumbung on the last beat]
Ora gugup, ora gugup
